historical_ampelopsis_arborea.habit: Woody, bushy to moderately high-climbing vine
historical_ampelopsis_arborea.leaves: Usually (9–)11–34 or more leaflets; oblong-elliptic dark-green coarsely toothed lobed or unlobed, up to 3–7 cm
historical_ampelopsis_arborea.habitat: Stream bottoms, fence lines, disturbed ground
